newsitem.title: ITALY: Alenia in 700bln lire deal with McDonnell Douglas.
newsitem.headline: Alenia in 700bln lire deal with McDonnell Douglas.

text.p: Alenia, a unit of state-controlled engineering group Finmeccanica, has signed a 700 billion lire deal with U.S. company McDonnell Douglas, the firm said in a statement.

It said the agreement involved transforming 13 DC10-10 into cargo aircraft from passenger planes. Alenia added that the contract included an option for the transformation of a further 30 DC 10s and the supply of modification kits to McDonnell.
Alenia said the modified airplanes had been ordered by the U.S. firm Federal Express, based in Memphis, which is looking to expand its operations. It did not say when the DC10s would be delivered.
Alenia has developed a speciality modifying DC8s and DC10s. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
